# tuannx/maven

> Personal fork of Apache Maven. The added CI aid is the composite action `build-speedup-bench`. Do not open pull requests or comments on apache/maven. Do not treat this fork as an Apache release.

Full contract: [.github/actions/build-speedup-bench/llms.txt](.github/actions/build-speedup-bench/llms.txt)

## Copy

`v1` is a moving tag cut on master after merge. Pin a commit SHA until that tag exists.

```yaml
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: write

steps:
  - uses: actions/checkout@v7
  - uses: tuannx/maven/.github/actions/build-speedup-bench@v1
    with:
      pom: pom.xml
```

This fork's dogfood passes `pom: api/pom.xml` and uses `uses: ./.github/actions/build-speedup-bench`. PR check name: `build-speedup-bench`.

## Contract (short)

- Scenarios, comma-separated: `mvn`, `mvnd`, `build-cache`. Default all three.
- Outputs: `mvn-median-seconds`, `warm-mvnd-seconds`, `warm-mvnd-speedup` (decimal, no `x`), `cache-no-change-seconds`, `summary-path`.
- Table is appended to `GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY`. Logs artifact: `build-speedup-bench-logs`.
- Build-cache extension is opt-in and removed before the action exits. Refuses to start if `.mvn/extensions.xml` or `.mvn/maven-build-cache-config.xml` already exists.
- Does not fail when the speedup is small.
- `sticky-comment` defaults to false. True requires `pull-requests: write` and a `pull_request` event.
- Does not create the `v1` tag.
